summary: Phase 149O.1G -- HATP Proof Models + Canonical Serialization Implementation (Wave 3): implemented HumanApprovalProvenanceProof, frozen proof_version=1, discriminated Ag3OperationReference/Ag5OperationReference typed operation models, strict closed-schema parsing, and deterministic canonical serialization + SHA-256 digest of the canonical signed payload, in one new module src/pcae/core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py. Status: completed. Completeness: all Wave-3-owned requirements (HATP-REQ-067..075, HATP-REQ-117) mapped and tested; the required-initial-inspection commands were run and their results confirmed against the prior phase's own claims (repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.1F.2 complete, Wave 1/2 verified, B-149O.1F-1 confirmed closed, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable) before any file was touched; primary sources (HATP-001, the 149O.1D implementation plan, the verified Wave-1/2 source) were read directly, not summarized from memory. Files changed: 1 new production module, 3 new test files, 1 widened pre-existing phase-scoped test file (test_phase_149o_1e_...py, additive-only expected-file-set widening), tests/conftest.py (Fast Green marker registration, additive-only), 1 new implementation doc, PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, plus task-lifecycle files. Production diff is exactly one new file: src/pcae/core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py (git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -- src/pcae/ confirms this). Contract boundary: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -- docs/contracts/ is empty -- HATP-001 v1.0 untouched. Wave-1/2 boundary: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -- src/pcae/core/repository_identity.py src/pcae/core/hatp_bootstrap.py is empty. RAE/Permission-Broker/agent boundary: all confirmed empty via the same diff check. Schema strictness mechanism: an explicit allowed/present/unknown set-difference check (_build_proof_from_document), mirroring the exact pattern already used by the verified Wave-2 sibling module hatp_bootstrap.py's own _parse_* functions, rather than a jsonschema-based additionalProperties:false resource file -- a deliberate implementation choice within the space HATP-REQ-075 leaves open, documented explicitly in the phase doc (section 4) as a variance from the 149O.1D plan's illustrative example, satisfying the phase's literal requirement text ("additionalProperties: false or an equivalent strict typed parser"). F-149O.1C-1 disposition: IMPLEMENTED HARDENING -- an otherwise-valid proof carrying one unrecognized field is rejected outright (test_f_149o_1c_1_unknown_field_hardening_is_enforced, plus a broader unknown-field/self-selected-authority-field parametrized matrix); HATP-001's own text is unmodified. Discriminated operation models: Ag3OperationReference (job_id, original_commit_sha) and Ag5OperationReference (per_id, ecp_id) are distinct frozen dataclasses, never a single loose optional-field dict; HumanApprovalProvenanceProof.__post_init__ enforces the family/type match even against direct dataclass construction, mirroring RAE-001's own RollbackApprovalBinding.__post_init__ pattern. Duplicate JSON keys: rejected via a custom object_pairs_hook (_reject_duplicate_keys), tested with an injected duplicate against a full valid document, not merely a two-key toy example. Canonical serialization: json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8"), mirroring cltr/canonicalization.py and rollback_approval_evidence.py's own existing convention rather than inventing a new one; digest is plain lowercase hex SHA-256, matching the project's existing digest convention (no algorithm prefix, no new domain-separation semantics introduced). Timestamp handling: issued_at is parsed via a fail-closed, timezone-aware ISO-8601 parser duplicated (not imported) from repository_identity.py/hatp_bootstrap.py/rollback_approval_evidence.py::_parse_iso_timestamp (avoiding the Python 3.9 fromisoformat Z-suffix defect this project already hit once), then re-rendered to one canonical millisecond-precision UTC Z-suffixed form at parse time, so two differently-formatted-but-equivalent input timestamps canonicalize identically. Golden vectors: fixed AG3 and AG5 canonical-byte and digest vectors asserted exactly, intended as compatibility anchors for a future Wave 4/5 implementation. Mutation-sensitivity matrix: every AG3 field and every AG5-specific field, individually mutated, changes both canonical bytes and digest (parametrized test matrix). Adversarial coverage: unknown top-level field; self-selected trust/authority fields (trusted_root, trusted_public_key, attestation_root, authority_registry, canonical_root, trust_store_root, deployment_root); authority booleans (approved, trusted, authorized, human_present, valid); AG3 discriminator with AG5 fields and vice versa; AG3 discriminator with AG5-only payload; mixed-family fields; missing operation family entirely; every individual missing required field for both families; malformed repository_id/digest/commit-SHA/timestamp formats; unsupported/missing/non-integer/boolean proof_version; top-level JSON array instead of object; invalid JSON; duplicate JSON key (both a minimal two-key example and an injection into a full valid document). Dependency-direction/import-boundary audit: AST-based (not grep-only) confirmation that the new module imports only pcae.core.repository_identity.is_valid_repository_instance_id and nothing from hatp_bootstrap.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py, permission_broker*.py, agent.py, or commands/agent.py. No-verification-vocabulary audit: no member of HATP-REQ-078's closed 13-state vocabulary is defined; no public callable name contains verify/trusted/authorized and none is named is_valid; no approval_present/HATP_TRUSTED_OPERATIONAL/HATP_VALID symbol exists; no cryptography/FIDO2/WebAuthn/PIV library reference exists anywhere in the module's source (all AST/source-scan-confirmed, not merely asserted). Purity audit: no filesystem, network, or wall-clock ("now") dependency anywhere in the module (source-scan-confirmed plus a behavioral test that deletes the cwd underneath the process and still succeeds). Combined Wave-1/2 foundation regression (test_repository_identity.py + test_hatp_bootstrap_foundation.py + test_phase_149o_1e_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_1_...py): 103 passed, matching the entering baseline exactly. 149O.1F.2 independent re-verification suite: 90 passed, matching baseline. HATP contract + implementation-plan regression (149O.1C + 149O.1D suites): 127 passed, matching baseline. New Wave-3 suite (test_hatp_proof_models.py + test_hatp_canonical_serialization.py + test_phase_149o_1g_...py): 100 passed. Fast Green: 4531 passed (4431 entering baseline + 100 new deterministic, hardware- and environment-independent Wave-3 tests, all three new test modules registered in tests/conftest.py's FAST_GREEN_MODULES) -- no regression. RAE/Permission-Broker/agent broadened regression: 5 failed / 5626 passed; the same 5 failures independently reproduced identically against the unmodified tree via git stash push -u / rerun / git stash pop -- confirmed pre-existing and unrelated, matching 149O.1F.2's own already-recorded pre-existing-failure disposition for these exact test IDs. Full suite: 97 failed / 28145 passed / 10 skipped under -n auto (1:26:08); a serial --lf rerun (-n0) narrowed this to 75 failed / 22 passed -- the 22-test delta is -n auto parallel-worker-only cross-test interference (shared temp/env state across wheel-build/sdist-packaging and Telegram-notification tests), not a genuine failure; the remaining 75 were independently reproduced identically (same 75 test IDs) against the unmodified tree via the same stash/rerun/pop procedure -- confirmed entirely pre-existing, none touching HATP, repository_identity.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, RAE, or the Permission Broker. This phase's own reconfirmed pre-existing-failure count (75) differs from 149O.1F.2's recorded baseline (68) because of pre-existing drift on main between the two phases that predates and is independent of this phase's own diff, itself reconfirmed by the identical stash-based reproduction. Findings: no BLOCKING findings. Verdict: HATP WAVE 3 IMPLEMENTED -- PROOF MODELS + CANONICAL SERIALIZATION READY FOR INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. HATP production readiness unaffected: NOT READY (proof verifier, hardware provider, Class-B deployment, RAE integration all still absent). B-149O-1 through B-149O-4 remain OPEN, unaffected. F-149O.1C-2 remains editorial debt only. HATP-001 v1.0 remains byte-unchanged. Recommended next phase: 149O.1H -- HATP Proof Models + Canonical Serialization Independent Verification. See docs/PHASE_149O_1G_HATP_PROOF_MODELS_CANONICAL_SERIALIZATION_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
